newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said mutual recognition agreements (MRA) had been reached with the U.S. and Canada. He said they would be signed next week.

Spokesman Peter Guilford briefed on Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan's official visit to Russia on Monday and Tuesday. Discussions will focus on Russia's accession to the World Trade Organisation, which is one of the major potential accessions on the trade policy agenda, Guilford said.

Spokeswoman Sarah Lambert briefed on Tuesday and Wednesday's Transport Council. She said main issues on the agenda would be exchange of information as regards aircraft from third countries flying in and out of EU airports, proposed European Aviation Safety Authority, sea passenger registration and road safety. Lambert said that current statistics estimated that one in eighty people living in the EU would die in a car accident.

Spokesman Patrick Child said there could be an informal ECOFIN Council on Sunday in Amsterdam. He said Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy would try to meet reporters around 1730/1530 GMT in the Press Centre.

Asked to react to the Dutch Presidency's new proposals on institutional reforms that imply that some institutional modifications would be taken after an EU enlargement, Vale de Almeida said Commission President Jacques Santer had recently underlined the risk of a weakening of the IGC conclusions before the EU summit. Vale de Almeida also denied that Santer was satisfied with news proposals.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/514: EU reaches agreements to cut red tape with United States and Canada.
- IP/97/515: Commission approves the registration of a fourth list of agricultural and food products.
- IP/97/518: The Commission clears the creation of a joint venture between Vallourec and Timet.
- IP/97/519: Commission clears the acquisition by Abeille Vie of sole control of Societe d'Epargne Viagere and Sinafer.
- Speech/97/137: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn at GDMU Biennal Delegate Conference on "partnership for a new organisation work".
- Eurostat news release No 40/97: Unemployment in EU regions.
